foundation: Church's Simple Theory of Types (3 primitive axioms: ETA_AX, SELECT_AX, INFINITY_AX)

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Direct tactical application of the Peano induction theorem or theorem returned by new_inductive_definition.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Pair INDUCT_TAC with tactical composition THENL branching on base and step goals.
dialect_pitfalls: Loss of antecedent context if not popped and generalized before induction
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Conversion functions term -> thm producing equational theorems |- t = t' purely through kernel primitive inference steps.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Chain conversions CBV_CONV or custom equational simplifiers through CONV_TAC.
dialect_pitfalls: Slow execution on large numeric certificates compared to compiled VM evaluation
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Repeated top-down rewrite conversion using an equational database until a normal form is reached.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use PURE_REWRITE_TAC when standard rewrites (basic_rewrites) interfere with goal structure.
dialect_pitfalls: Unbounded loop in REWRITE_TAC on reflexivity permutations like commutativity without AC handling
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Unbundled Simple Type Theory: groups and rings are explicit tuples or predicates over sets; no native typeclass engine.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Pass structure dictionaries explicitly or bundle carrier sets with operation records.
dialect_pitfalls: Heavy manual plumbing of structure dictionaries across every lemma
No automated resolution of default operators
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: MESON [lem1; lem2] `!x. P x ==> Q x`
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Model elimination (MESON), resolution (METIS), and exact linear arithmetic decision procedures producing kernel certificates.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Pass explicit lemma lists into MESON_TAC for first-order logic subgoals.
dialect_pitfalls: Exponential search blowup if irrelevant lemmas are provided in search list
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: MATCH_MP_TAC REAL_LE_TRANS THEN EXISTS_TAC `b:real` THEN CONJ_TAC
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit forward or backward application of transitivity theorems (LE_TRANS, EQ_TRANS).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Compose conversions or forward transitivity rules with MATCH_MP.
dialect_pitfalls: Manual introduction and maintenance of intermediate terms
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Equivalence classes modeled as subsets of the carrier type with canonical representative selection.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use the HOL Light quotient library to define canonical representatives and lift equational theorems.
dialect_pitfalls: Heavy manual management of equivalence class sets without kernel quotient support
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Application of axioms generated by define_type stating constructor inequality and injectivity.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use REWRITE_TAC with datatype axiom theorems or dedicated distinctness tactics.
dialect_pitfalls: Manual decomposition of multi-argument constructor equalities
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit relational and functional definitions over subset lattices or complete partial orders.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Instantiate general Knaster-Tarski theorems manually for monotonic set operators.
dialect_pitfalls: No typeclass engine to automatically infer lattice operations across numeric and set domains
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Axiom of type definition in Church's Simple Type Theory; introduces bijection between the new type and a subset of an existing type.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Maintain explicit bijection theorems dest_mytype (mk_mytype x) = x.
dialect_pitfalls: Heavy manual management of isomorphism theorems for every compound operation
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Classical HOL with Hilbert's choice operator as primitive; SELECT_AX : |- P x ==> P (@x. P x).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Discharge existential obligations by choosing canonical witnesses with @x. P x.
dialect_pitfalls: Lack of constructive extraction
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: System transitions defined by relational clauses; invariant induction over transitive closures.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prove base step and inductive step via INV_INDUCT.
dialect_pitfalls: Manual reconstruction of state space equivalence lemmas
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: LCF-verified linear/ring decision procedures (`ARITH_TAC` on `num`, `INT_ARITH_TAC` on `int`, `REAL_ARITH_TAC` and `REAL_RING` on `real`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `ARITH_TAC` / `INT_ARITH_TAC` -> `omega`, `REAL_ARITH_TAC` -> `linarith`, and `REAL_RING` -> `ring`.
dialect_pitfalls: `REAL_RING` handles non-zero denominator clearing internally; in Lean 4 run `field_simp` before `ring`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Rewrite suites pushing `&n` (`real_of_num`) outward/inward and `REAL_FIELD` reducing field goals to Positivstellensatz/ring obligations.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `REWRITE_TAC[REAL_OF_NUM_CLAUSES]` to `norm_cast` and `CONV_TAC REAL_FIELD` to `field_simp; ring`.
dialect_pitfalls: `REAL_OF_NUM_SUB` requires `m <= n` as an explicit antecedent just like `Nat.cast_sub`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Harrison's general recursive `define` command backed by `WF_REC` and `MEASURE`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `MATCH_MP_TAC WF_IND` to `fun_induction` or `WellFounded.induction`.
dialect_pitfalls: HOL Light does not automatically generate a custom `f.induct` theorem for `define`; Lean 4's `fun_induction` simplifies these proofs substantially
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: (f has_integral y) s | integral s f | negligible s
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Henstock-Kurzweil gauge integral on `real^N` (`has_integral`) and Lebesgue measurable sets (`measurable`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `(f has_integral y) s` on absolutely integrable functions to `HasIntegral f s y` / `IntegrableOn f s volume ∧ ∫ x in s, f x = y`.
dialect_pitfalls: Henstock-Kurzweil integrates conditionally convergent oscillations (e.g. `sin x / x` on `[0, ∞)`) that are not Lebesgue/Bochner `Integrable` without improper limit wrappers
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: sum s f | nsum (1..n) f | product s f
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `iterate (+) s f` over predicates `s : A -> bool` (`sum` for `real`, `nsum` for `num`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `nsum (0..n-1) f` -> `∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i` and `nsum (m..n) f` -> `∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m n, f i`.
dialect_pitfalls: HOL Light `(m..n)` is the closed interval `[m, n]`, not half-open
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Harrison's `Library/words.ml` (`s2n-bignum`) bit-blaster `WORD_BLAST` and modular arithmetic `WORD_ARITH_TAC`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace `CONV_TAC WORD_BLAST` with `by bv_decide` and `WORD_ARITH_TAC` with `by bv_omega`.
dialect_pitfalls: Check `val` (unsigned) vs `ival` (signed 2's complement) projections -> `BitVec.toNat` vs `BitVec.toInt` in Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Derived function extensionality (`FUN_EQ_THM` from `ETA_AX`), set extensionality (`EXTENSION`), and LCF congruence (`AP_TERM_TAC`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `REWRITE_TAC[FUN_EQ_THM]` and `REWRITE_TAC[EXTENSION]` to `ext x` and `AP_TERM_TAC` to `congrArg`.
dialect_pitfalls: HOL Light sets ARE predicates `A -> bool`, so `EXTENSION` and `FUN_EQ_THM` are identical up to `IN` (`∈`) notation
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: (f --> l) (at a within s) | (s ---> l) sequentially
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Directed nets (`net`) with `at a`, `at a within s`, `sequentially`, and `at_posinfinity`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `(s ---> l) sequentially` -> `Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 l)` and `(f --> l) (at a)` -> `Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 l)`.
dialect_pitfalls: Like Isabelle, HOL Light's `at a` is punctured (`0 < dist(x,a) < d`), corresponding to `𝓝[≠] a` (`nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ`) in Mathlib
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
